Duality.def: Every phenomenon has a complementary Energy–Anergy pair

Symmetry.def: Structural invariance across transformations and perspectives

Emergence.def: New properties arise irreducibly from component interactions

Invariance.def: Core properties preserved under change and transformation

Reductionism.def: Complex phenomena reduced to fundamental CEN constituents

Holism.def: The whole transcends and cannot be derived from its parts

Composition.def: Complex structures built hierarchically from simpler components

Simulation.def: Reality as a computational or consciousness-driven process

Structuralism.def: Meaning and identity arise from relational structure, not substance

Light.desc: Pure radiant energy — consciousness made visible

Void.desc: Primordial emptiness — the ground of potential

Air (Thought).desc: The medium of mind and intellectual movement

Earth (Womb).desc: Hidden generative matter — containment and gestation

Water (Blood).desc: The sacred fluid sustaining all life

Iron.desc: The metal of labor, will, and technological power

Wind.desc: Rapid invisible movement — speed and impermanence

Ether (Mind).desc: The fifth element — pure conscious space

Earth (Dense).desc: Heavy compacted matter — weight, constraint, endurance

Sound (Vibration).desc: Creative acoustic wave — the divine word made manifest

Wood (Deep Roots).desc: Patient organic structure — deep time and growth

Honey (Sweet Water).desc: Sweet abundance — the nectar of prosperity

White Clay (Purity).desc: Pure creative medium — divine blank slate
